cards.heading: Book a Table
cards.body: Walk-ins are welcome at the bar. Reservations are recommended for dining and brunch, especially during busy weekend periods.

cards.heading: Plan Your Event
cards.body: Planning a birthday, corporate event, bachelorette party, rehearsal dinner or venue buyout? Send your date and headcount to the Miss B's events team.

inquiry.heading: Private Event Inquiry
inquiry.body: Tell us your event date, approximate headcount and what you're planning. Our events team will follow up with availability and options for the space.
